thread:
Sam P.: @Ari C. quick handoff for Orca (healthtech). Signed E-50 seat, start next week. They want Dedicated with VPC and an on-prem eval window. Key blockers: SSO/SAML metadata needed, custom logging endpoint, and data retention SLA. Renewal note: 12mo term, finance needs invoice timeline nailed (30 days). Deal doc: https://paper.example/orca-deal-4521. Can CS pick this up?

Ari C.: Thanks Sam — taking lead for onboarding. I'll own enablement + kickoff. Adding owners: enablement = Ari C.; technical setup (provisioning/SSO) = Priya S.; support primary = Taylor L.; eng escalation = Jorge M.

Sam P.: SAML metadata + certs are in the doc under "integration". Orca infra lead is Emma N. for the on-prem validation. POC target = 2 weeks.

Priya S.: OK. I'll open the provisioning checklist ticket. Two asks: 1) need the SAML metadata file (xml) uploaded to the ticket, 2) confirm whether their logging endpoint expects TLS mutual auth.

Sam P.: attached SAML metadata to the doc now (or search "saml_orca.xml"). Logging endpoint note: they want mTLS, certs to be exchanged during provision.

Priya S.: Copy. Creating Support ticket -> ORCA-4521-provision in Zendesk and CC'ing @Taylor L. Will paste initial payload for infra: 
```
POST /provision
{
  "account_id": "ORCA-4521",
  "deployment": "dedicated",
  "vpc": true,
  "mTLS": true
}
```
Include SAML metadata and contact Emma.N@orca.co in the ticket.

Taylor L.: I'll schedule the 1:1 enablement + security review. Tentative slots: Tue 10am PT or Wed 2pm PT. Which works for Emma + PS team? I'll send calendar invite once confirmed.

Jorge M.: FYI eng: dedicated capacity review needed. What's expected qps and seq length? Also need compliance doc for on-prem eval (data deletion + audit logs). I'll open internal GH issue rwinf/ops#4521 and tag infra/runtime.

Ari C.: Expected steady qps ~ 40 req/s with peaks to 120 for first 2 weeks. Typical prompt max tokens ~ 2048. Renewal risk: they asked about cost guarantees; flag as "renewal-watch" — finance follow-up required at 9mo.

Sam P.: I'll triage finance ask. I'll also DM Emma to confirm availability for the POC slots and loop back here.

oncall-bot: New support ticket created: ORCA-4521-provision (https://zendesk.example/tickets/82461). Assignee: Priya S.

Priya S.: Ticket created and initial provisioning steps kicked off. Next steps: 1) Priya to confirm SAML/mTLS cert exchange process (owner: Priya S.), 2) Taylor to run enablement + security kickoff (owner: Taylor L.), 3) Jorge to land GH issue for capacity + compliance (owner: Jorge M.), 4) Ari to run customer kickoff and collect success criteria (owner: Ari C.), 5) Sam to coordinate finance and Emma contact (owner: Sam P.).

Taylor L.: I invited Sam and Ari to Wed 2pm PT. Emma confirmed Wed works. Invite includes pre-read: onboarding checklist + infra questions.

Ari C.: Summarizing action items for internal trackers and tagging owners. Will update the deal doc with owners + expected dates. Please add any missing items.

Sam P.: Great — thanks team. :thumbsup:
